item.title: Five takeaways on the search for Savannah Guthrie's mother
item.description: Law enforcement provided new details on Thursday in the search for Nancy Guthrie, the 84-year-old mother of the “Today” show co-anchor Savannah Guthrie who went missing from her home this weekend in what officials believe to be an abduction.
